building_title: Локальные очистные сооружения поверхностных сточных вод

approval.quote:
1. Sandwich panels: solid colour without joints (module not confirmed by the drawings).
2. Roof: RAL 7004 grey (as KPP 7004), not 5015.
3. Mixed ID: allowed to paint parts differently (roof 7004, frame/carcass 7004, plinth/drop = wall colour) WITHOUT changing geometry - via UV/atlas regions or splitting face groups inside the same ID.
4. Panels RAL 5015 = KPP blue, doors/frames/porches RAL 7004 = KPP grey, glass as KPP; the drop below +-0.000 = wall colour.
AC04: small frames of ID4 = RAL 7004.
approval.geometry_untouched: Only paint. Geometry, topology, UCX and multisub IDs stay exactly as in the source scene. VPM/NPM (UDIM/atlas) of this building are built by a separate build card, not here.
approval.point_1_superseded_by: joint_spec on ID1 region wall panels and ID2; Gate-1 point 1 is not the live panel rule

materials.component: External shell, structural strips, roof and below-grade base
materials.finish: Mixed paint inside the same ID, geometry untouched: roof and frame/carcass RAL7004; wall panels RAL5015 with vertical joints only (joint_spec); below-grade drop RAL5015 plain, no joints. Face groups are not separated in geometry-174.json.

regions.need: geometry-174.json has vertices, triangles and material_ids only. All 780 ID1 triangles share material id 1. Upward-facing ID1 triangles occur at several heights (z max about 0.238, 2.397, 3.227, 3.240, 3.387 and 3.419 m) and are not labeled roof. Need an existing face-index or UV-island list that isolates the roof. This card does not invent that split.

kpp_reference.sampling: exact uniform RGB; all pixels checked

regions.need: geometry-174.json does not separate frame or carcass faces inside material id 1. ID2 is a different material (recessed infill), not this region. Need an existing face-index list for the carcass inside ID1. This card does not invent that split.

kpp_reference.sampling: exact uniform RGB; all pixels checked

regions.need: geometry-174.json has no wall-panel face group inside material id 1. Recessed panel infill is already ID2. Need an existing face-index list if any ID1 faces are wall panels rather than carcass. This card does not invent that split.

kpp_reference.sampling: exact uniform RGB; all pixels checked
kpp_reference.role: colour reference only; panel joints come from source_texture

joint_spec.layout: Layout is per facade, from joint_spec.per_facade, phase symmetric in the panel field. The 4096 source is not a tiling source: it supplies colour, noise and the profile of one joint only. At 1000 px/m a 0.20 m step would be about 200 px. The texture period is not a fallback step. Where a facade is unresolved, the build does not invent a rib count.
joint_spec.udim_fit: No new cuts are needed for a 0.20 m step when the UV of a face lies in one 4K tile (4096 px at 1000 px/m covers 4.096 m). A ring cut or an edge loop is allowed only where a face still does not fit one 4K tile, and that cut is reported in the build card. This card does not cut geometry. Quads stay. Silhouette, normals, UCX and multisub IDs stay.

supersedes.replaced: Sandwich panels: solid colour without joints (module not confirmed by the drawings).
supersedes.not_a_fallback: The texture period is not the layout step.

questions.question: Approve the proposed ID 1/2 blue, ID 3 glass, ID 4 grey, ID 5 yellow mapping on the contact sheet? Diagnostic colours identify IDs, not finish colours.
questions.answer: Approved 2026-10-22. Panels RAL 5015 = KPP blue, doors/frames/porches RAL 7004 = KPP grey, glass as KPP; roof RAL 7004 grey (as KPP 7004), not 5015; the drop below +-0.000 = wall colour. A mixed ID may be painted by region without changing geometry.

questions.question: ID 4 combines a door and small opening frames. Proposal: RAL7004 for both, with M_Glass_01 in ID 3. The legend explicitly specifies doors but not small frames: approve frame grey?
questions.answer: Approved 2026-10-22. AC04 small frames of ID4 = RAL 7004.

questions.question: No verified dimensioned panel joint module was identified. Proposal: solid RAL5015 without fabricated cassette/joint pattern. Approve solid for Gate 1, or provide the panel module drawing?
questions.answer: Answered by joint_spec on the RAL5015 panel regions (ID1 wall panels and ID2): orientation vertical_only, per_facade rib count and step from the colour sheet, joint_width_mm 8, texel_px_per_m 1000, phase symmetric in the panel field, below_grade plain_no_joints. Facades whose ribs are not one even step stay unresolved and are listed in joint_report. Supersedes Gate-1 point 1.

DWG:170B10.text: Сэндвич-панели, козырёк - RAL 5015; Крыльца, двери - RAL 7004; Ограждения металлической лестницы - RAL 1021

conflicts.disposition: Documented only; scene geometry final, no geometry edits per orchestrator.

source_copy_mutation.disposition: Working copy retained; frozen v003 package independently matches Desktop originals. Cause unknown.

perimeter_drop.policy: Keep full drop, same finish as the adjacent wall (RAL5015); no cut at ground and no new ID. Geometry untouched. Orchestrator relay of Artem decision 2026-10-22. Below +-0.000 the finish is plain colour, with no joints.

joint_report.note: Unresolved facades do not revoke gate_1_status approved-gate1. The build does not invent a count and does not fall back to 0.60 m.

acceptance_picture.rule: Each facade render must be placed next to the same facade of the colour sheet, at the same scale, with the rib count written under both. A render whose rib count differs from the sheet count is not sent to Artem.
